newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening little changed Monday, in line with LME copper, with the market seen finding some support after last week's downward correction to a six week long rally.
COMEX July copper was seen opening unchanged to down 0.20 cent from Friday's close at 117.15 cents, after trading between 117.00 and 117.10 in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME warehouse stocks fell 1,750 tonnes in Monday's data to 130,875 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks fell 57 short tons to 42,028 short tons Friday.
